item.title: ‘Turn the page quickly’: Atlanta United looks to avoid 0-2 start in San Jose this weekend
item.description: Atlanta United manager Tata Martino and midfielder Alexey Miranchuk spoke to the media ahead of their game against the San Jose Earthquakes, emphasizing the need to be aggressive and improve on their build-up from the last game. The post ‘Turn the page quickly’: Atlanta United looks to avoid 0-2 start in San Jose this weekend appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Faith on the Frontline doc screens at Morehouse College
item.description: Morehouse College hosted the world premiere screening of "Faith on the Frontline," a documentary chronicling the NCC's 75 years of shared ecumenical witness for justice, peace, and moral leadership, featuring former Atlanta Mayor and United Nations Ambassador Andrew Young reflecting on the church's central role in the civil rights movement. The post Faith on the Frontline doc screens at Morehouse College appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Johnson Lowe Gallery Opens “Dangerous Games,” Second Solo Exhibition by Navin Norling
item.description: Navin Norling's solo exhibition, Dangerous Games, opened at Johnson Lowe Gallery, featuring works that dissect classic Americana imagery through found materials, folk traditions, and layered visual codes, and is a commentary on American history, cultural erasure, and the political moment. The post Johnson Lowe Gallery Opens “Dangerous Games,” Second Solo Exhibition by Navin Norling appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Only the Four Black male candidates show up for Democratic governors forum in Clayton County
item.description: Four Black men running for Georgia's top seat, along with a Black moderator and invocation, took part in a gubernatorial forum in Clayton County, the seventh-largest county in Georgia, hosted by the Clayton County Democratic Party and the Young Democrats of Clayton County. The post Only the Four Black male candidates show up for Democratic governors forum in Clayton County appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Atlanta Hawks and Chase Bank host third annual Rookie Entrepreneur Program
item.description: Ten Georgia-based small business owners gathered for the third annual Rookie Entrepreneur Community Program, a partnership between the Atlanta Hawks and JPMorgan Chase, to receive financial tools and guidance to scale their businesses. The post Atlanta Hawks and Chase Bank host third annual Rookie Entrepreneur Program appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Meet Ashleigh Pearson, the chocolatier making fine dining chocolates accessible
item.description: Ashleigh Pearson, one of the few Black women chocolatiers in the country, has created Avec Noelle to make fine confections accessible to everyone, using her expertise in pastry and chocolate making to create nostalgic, community-focused bonbons. The post Meet Ashleigh Pearson, the chocolatier making fine dining chocolates accessible appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘I Can Win This’: A Black woman is qualified to run in Georgia Secretary of State race
item.description: Penny Brown Reynolds and Kelvin King are running to be the first Black Secretary of State in Georgia, with Adrian Consonery, Jr. also running for the Democratic seat, and the voters will decide if a Black Georgia Secretary of State will be elected. The post ‘I Can Win This’: A Black woman is qualified to run in Georgia Secretary of State race appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘Forsaken, Not Forgotten’: Scholar Brings Sudan’s To War to Atlanta
item.description: The war in Sudan has killed tens of thousands and displaced over 11 million people, with the international community largely ignoring the crisis and foreign powers fueling the conflict.
